proof_summary: For fixed C>=0, v2(phi(n))>=floor(log2 n)-C implies oddpart(phi(n))<B=2^(C+1). Then every odd prime factor has p=1+d*2^r, odd d<B. Large p>B appear only to exponent one. For n<=X, sum r<=R=floor(log2 X). Subset count bounded by prod_r(1+t^r)^B and Chernoff exp(2 sqrt(BR)). Small prime exponent choices D_B and power of 2 choices R+1 complete the explicit count. A nearlog termwise-integer totient window gives a nearmax final-index witness, hence at most X^o(1) starts. Finite *sum* integrality is not controlled.
